newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Plessey division appoints new MD.
newsitem.headline: Plessey division appoints new MD.

text.p: Electronics firm Plessey Corp said on Thursday it had appointed Llew Jones managing director of its main South African subsidiary Plessey SA.

The company said in a statement the move would allow the chief executive John Temple, who is relinquishing the post of managing director of Plessey SA, to focus on group development locally and internationally.
Plessey SA comprises stand-alone divisions which deal with project management, telecommunications, professional electronics, manufacturing and technology.
Temple said rapid expansion over the past five years had strained management resources.
"We are resolving this problem through the introduction of several new executives," he said.
